satya_nadella.headline: Chairman and CEO at Microsoft
satya_nadella.summary: Satya Nadella is Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Microsoft. Before being named CEO in February 2014, Nadella held leadership roles in both enterprise and consumer businesses across the company. Joining Microsoft in 1992, he quickly became known for his energy, intellectual curiosity and drive to bring out the best in people. He has led major technical strategy shifts including the move to cloud computing and AI-first approaches.

experiences.title: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
experiences.description: Leading Microsoft's transformation into a cloud-first, AI-first company. Under his leadership, Microsoft's market cap grew from $300B to over $3T. Championed the acquisition of LinkedIn, GitHub, and Activision Blizzard. Drove the strategic partnership with OpenAI.

experiences.title: Executive Vice President, Cloud and Enterprise
experiences.description: Led the development of Microsoft Azure, growing it into one of the world's largest cloud platforms. Oversaw SQL Server, System Center, and Visual Studio.

experiences.title: Senior Vice President, Online Services Division
experiences.description: Led Bing search engine development and Microsoft's online services strategy.

experiences.title: Various Engineering and Leadership Roles
experiences.description: Progressed through engineering and management roles working on Windows, Office, and enterprise server products.

education.degree_name: Master of Science in Computer Science

education.school: University of Chicago Booth School of Business

accomplishment_publications.name: Hit Refresh: The Quest to Rediscover Microsoft's Soul and Imagine a Better Future for Everyone
accomplishment_publications.description: A book about personal transformation, Microsoft's cultural shift, and the coming wave of intelligent technology.

jensen_huang.headline: Founder and CEO at NVIDIA
jensen_huang.summary: Jensen Huang co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 and has served since its inception as president, chief executive officer and a member of the board of directors. NVIDIA pioneered GPU-accelerated computing to tackle challenges that no one else can solve. NVIDIA's invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined computer graphics, and ignited the era of modern AI.

experiences.title: Founder, President and Chief Executive Officer
experiences.description: Pioneered accelerated computing, transforming NVIDIA from a 3D graphics chip startup into the global leader in AI hardware, software platforms (CUDA), supercomputers, and autonomous machines. Built CUDA architecture in 2006, betting the company on parallel computing.

experiences.title: Director, Coreware Business Unit
experiences.description: Managed system-on-a-chip designs and microprocessors, coordinating silicon engineering teams.

experiences.title: Microprocessor Designer
experiences.description: Designed microprocessor silicon and computational logic units.

education.degree_name: Master of Science in Electrical Engineering
education.description: Focused on computer architecture and parallel processing systems.

education.degree_name: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering
education.description: Graduated in electrical engineering; met future wife and co-founder Lori Mills during lab work.

accomplishment_publications.name: Accelerating Modern Artificial Intelligence through Massively Parallel GPUs
accomplishment_publications.description: Comprehensive vision on combining deep learning frameworks with dedicated tensor processing units.

volunteer_work.title: Philanthropist & Benefactor
volunteer_work.description: Endowed the Jen-Hsun Huang Engineering Center at Stanford University and the Huang Collaborative Innovation Complex at Oregon State University.

sam_altman.headline: CEO at OpenAI | Co-Founder Tools for Humanity | Former President Y Combinator
sam_altman.summary: Entrepreneur, investor, and programmer. Currently CEO of OpenAI, developing safe and beneficial Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). Previously President of Y Combinator, funding thousands of startups including Airbnb, Stripe, Reddit, and DoorDash. Co-founded Loopt, an early location-based social networking app.

experiences.title: Chief Executive Officer
experiences.description: Leading OpenAI's mission to ensure artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Launched ChatGPT, GPT-4, and the modern wave of generative AI products.

experiences.title: President
experiences.description: Expanded YC's portfolio, launched the YC Research nonprofit lab, pioneered the SAFE financing instrument, and mentored hundreds of high-growth founders.

experiences.title: Co-Founder and CEO
experiences.description: Built one of the earliest mobile location-sharing social networks, accepted in YC's inaugural 2005 summer batch. Acquired by Green Dot Corporation for $43.4 million.

education.degree_name: Undergraduate Studies (Dropped out to build Loopt)
education.description: Studied AI and computer science under Andrew Ng; left in sophomore year upon acceptance to Y Combinator batch 2005.

accomplishment_publications.name: Moore's Law for Everything
accomplishment_publications.description: Essay outlining how AI will generate monumental wealth and change socioeconomic governance and taxation.

volunteer_work.title: Founding Benefactor & Chairman
volunteer_work.description: Funded comprehensive empirical randomized controlled trials studying the economic impact of unconditional basic income.

andrej_karpathy.headline: Founder at Eureka Labs | Former Director of AI at Tesla | OpenAI Founding Member
andrej_karpathy.summary: AI researcher, engineer, and educator passionate about deep neural networks, autonomous agents, and AI-native education. Completed PhD at Stanford under Fei-Fei Li. Founding research scientist at OpenAI, later Senior Director of AI at Tesla leading Autopilot vision and Full Self-Driving. Created widely acclaimed deep learning educational courses (CS231n, Neural Networks: Zero to Hero). Recently founded Eureka Labs to build an AI-native school.

experiences.title: Founder
experiences.description: Building an AI-native school where human teachers design high-quality courses supported by personalized AI teaching assistants.

experiences.title: Research Scientist
experiences.description: Returned to OpenAI working on foundational model training, reasoning architectures, and developer tooling.

experiences.title: Senior Director of AI
experiences.description: Led the computer vision and neural network team for Tesla Autopilot and Full Self-Driving (FSD). Architected large-scale neural network data collection pipelines (Data Engine) and vision-only occupancy networks.

experiences.title: Research Scientist & Founding Member
experiences.description: Conducted core research in generative models, reinforcement learning, and deep computer vision.

education.description: Advised by Fei-Fei Li. Created and taught the renowned CS231n course: Convolutional Neural Networks for Visual Recognition.
Researched physically simulated figure animations with machine learning advised by Michiel van de Panne.
First introduced to deep learning in Geoffrey Hinton's undergraduate lectures.

accomplishment_publications.name: Deep Visual-Semantic Alignments for Generating Image Descriptions
accomplishment_publications.description: Pioneered neural image captioning combining convolutional neural networks with recurrent neural networks.

accomplishment_publications.name: nanoGPT and llama2.c: Minimalist Pedagogical Implementations of Transformers
accomplishment_publications.description: Clean, educational pure C and PyTorch repositories teaching transformer training and inference from scratch.

feifei_li.headline: Sequoia Capital Professor of Computer Science at Stanford | Co-Director Stanford HAI | Creator of ImageNet
feifei_li.summary: Pioneer in artificial intelligence and computer vision. Inaugural Sequoia Capital Professor in the Computer Science Department at Stanford University and Denning Co-Director of the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI). Served as Chief Scientist of AI/ML at Google Cloud. Renowned as the inventor of ImageNet, the benchmark dataset that catalyzed modern deep learning. Co-founder of the non-profit AI4ALL.
feifei_li.occupation: Professor at Stanford University & Co-Director Stanford HAI

experiences.title: Professor of Computer Science & Co-Director Stanford HAI
experiences.description: Leading research in human-centered AI, spatial intelligence, robotics, and embodied AI. Directed the Stanford Artificial Intelligence Lab (SAIL) from 2013 to 2018.

experiences.title: Vice President & Chief Scientist of AI/ML
experiences.description: Led enterprise AI strategy, developed AutoML to democratize machine learning for businesses worldwide, and championed AI ethics principles.

experiences.title: Assistant Professor
experiences.description: Conducted groundbreaking research in visual recognition; launched the ImageNet project.

education.description: Advised by Pietro Perona and Christof Koch, integrating cognitive psychology with computer vision models.
Graduated with high honors in physics while simultaneously supporting family dry cleaning business.

accomplishment_publications.name: ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database
accomplishment_publications.description: Landmark paper introducing over 14 million labelled images that unlocked modern deep learning benchmarking.

accomplishment_publications.name: The Worlds I See: Curiosity, Exploration, and Discovery at the Dawn of AI
accomplishment_publications.description: Acclaimed scientific memoir exploring the immigrant journey and the genesis of modern artificial intelligence.

volunteer_work.title: Co-Founder and Chairperson of the Board
volunteer_work.description: Nonprofit dedicated to increasing diversity and inclusion in AI education for historically underrepresented high school students.

demis_hassabis.headline: CEO at Google DeepMind | 2024 Nobel Laureate in Chemistry | AI Pioneer
demis_hassabis.summary: Co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind, combining neuroscience, computer science, and machine learning to solve intelligence and advance scientific discovery. Awarded the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for breakthroughs in computational protein structure prediction with AlphaFold. Child chess prodigy, veteran video game designer (Theme Park), and Cambridge computer scientist.
demis_hassabis.occupation: Chief Executive Officer at Google DeepMind

experiences.title: Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer
experiences.description: Founded DeepMind in 2010 (acquired by Google in 2014). Led landmark AI breakthroughs including AlphaGo (defeating 18-time world champion Lee Sedol in 2016), AlphaZero, MuZero, and AlphaFold. Now spearheading the Gemini multi-modal frontier model program.

experiences.title: Founder and CEO
experiences.description: Founded independent video game development studio with 60+ engineers; created critically acclaimed simulation games Republic: The Revolution and Evil Genius.

experiences.title: Lead AI Programmer
experiences.description: Co-designed and coded the simulation AI for millions-selling blockbuster game Theme Park at age 17 alongside legendary designer Peter Molyneux.

education.description: Conducted seminal research on the neural mechanisms of episodic memory and imagination in the human hippocampus. Published breakthrough papers in Nature and PNAS.

education.degree_name: Bachelor of Arts (Double First Class Honours)
education.description: Completed double first-class honours in Computer Science at Cambridge at age 20.

accomplishment_publications.name: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
accomplishment_publications.description: Solved the 50-year-old grand biological challenge of protein folding, predicting 3D structures for virtually all known proteins; awarded 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

accomplishment_publications.name: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
accomplishment_publications.description: Historic paper introducing AlphaGo, the first computer program to defeat a human professional 9-dan Go player.

leonkatsnelson.headline: CTO | AI & Cloud Architecture | Former IBM Distinguished Engineer
leonkatsnelson.summary: Experienced technology executive with over 25 years in software engineering, cloud architecture, and artificial intelligence. Former IBM Distinguished Engineer and CTO of IBM Developer Skills Network. Passionate about developer education, open-source technologies, and building AI-powered tools that democratize access to technology. Led teams building cloud-native applications serving millions of learners worldwide.
leonkatsnelson.occupation: Chief Technology Officer at TechEd Solutions

experiences.title: Chief Technology Officer
experiences.description: Leading technology strategy and architecture for an AI-powered educational platform. Overseeing a team of 40+ engineers building cloud-native microservices on Kubernetes. Driving adoption of generative AI for personalized learning experiences.

experiences.title: Distinguished Engineer & CTO, Developer Skills Network
experiences.description: Led the architecture and development of IBM's Developer Skills Network, serving 5 million+ learners globally. Designed and implemented cloud-based lab environments using Kubernetes, Docker, and OpenShift. Pioneered the integration of AI-powered tutoring systems into the learning platform.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
experiences.description: Developed enterprise middleware solutions for IBM WebSphere. Contributed to open-source projects including Apache Kafka and Eclipse.

education.description: Specialized in distributed systems and artificial intelligence. Dean's List recipient.

education.school: Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto
education.description: Focused on technology management and entrepreneurship.

sample_data_scientist.headline: Senior Data Scientist at Google | NLP & Computer Vision | Ex-Amazon
sample_data_scientist.summary: Data scientist with 8+ years of experience in machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision. Currently building large-scale recommendation systems at Google. Previously worked on Alexa's conversational AI at Amazon. Published researcher with 12 papers in top-tier ML conferences. Passionate about making AI explainable and fair.

experiences.title: Senior Data Scientist
experiences.description: Building next-generation recommendation systems for YouTube using deep learning and reinforcement learning. Leading a team of 6 data scientists.

experiences.title: Data Scientist II, Alexa AI
experiences.description: Developed NLP models for Alexa's conversational understanding. Built intent classification systems processing 100M+ daily requests.
